notes.title: Möbler hotfix patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
v1.0.1 is now live for everyone to play!

We heard some of your issues and have rolled out a hotfix for you to make the play experience more fun and streamlined!

This hotfix includes the following changes:
- Fixed in-game audio not working.
- Removed survey link from the game over screen.
- Applied the correct application icon.

Thank you for your feedback.
Have fun playing and good luck reaching the stars,
The Möbler development team
